question: Should `skills.securityReview` become the permanent `operator.admin` pre-install trust contract for native clients?
rationale: The implementation and proof are strong, but automated review cannot choose the durable cross-client security API and ownership boundary.

options.title: Approve dedicated review RPC
options.body: Keep the exact-release preflight as the canonical native-client review contract, then regenerate and verify the final head.

options.title: Combine review and installation
options.body: Use server-issued review state or a token within one canonical installation workflow instead of a parallel review method.

options.title: Defer native installation
options.body: Land installed-skill search, filtering, and global toggles while postponing ClawHub installation.

recommendation.title: Approve dedicated review RPC
recommendation.body: Keep the exact-release preflight as the canonical native-client review contract, then regenerate and verify the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the native installation and fail-closed trust behavior that this API extends.
